name: Connecting Ridge, best-lit point
note: Ridge between Shackleton and de Gerlache craters. Best-lit point at 2 m height in Glaser et al. 2018. Blue Origin's Blue Moon MK1 pathfinder also targets this ridge.
source: Glaser et al. 2018, Planetary and Space Science 162, Table 2 (NTRS 20170007365)
terrain: LOLA 20 m near field, 80 m and 240 m far field

name: Shackleton crater rim

terrain: LOLA 20 m near field, 80 m and 240 m far field

name: Peak near Shackleton (Bussey point D)
note: Most-lit point of 2020 in Bussey et al. 2010. China's Chang'e 7 targets this area (launch now planned for 2027).

terrain: LOLA 20 m near field, 80 m and 240 m far field
